system_description.narrative_title: Middle East conflict destabilises global energy, shipping and security
system_description.narrative_summary: A cascade of attacks around the Gulf, Red Sea and Yemen — including tanker strikes, Houthi/ Iran-related strikes and a high-profile in-flight cockpit attack — is disrupting oil flows, shipping routes and perceptions of regional security. As an open system, flows of oil, ships, military forces, information and market expectations cross the system boundary and generate reinforcing feedbacks: attacks reduce physical supply and raise insurance/logistics costs, markets and governments respond with reserve releases and military repositioning, and those responses in turn shape actors' incentives and further escalation risks. The result is volatile energy markets, strained logistics (rerouting, Arctic transits), and cross-domain security measures from naval deployments to aviation checks that link local conflicts to the global economy.
system_description.scope: Inside: Gulf maritime chokepoints (Strait of Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb), Middle East combatants and proxies (Iran, Houthis, Yemen, Israel, Saudi Arabia), tanker and shipping routes, regional oil production and OPEC+ output decisions, strategic fuel reserves and G7/IEA interventions, global crude/diesel markets and refiners, military deployments and bases, aviation security incidents and airline operations, logistics/insurance and downstream fuel distribution.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical–energy–economic system (international trade, finance, and security architecture that governs energy supply, transportation and markets)
adjacent_subsystems: Strategic oil inventories, commodity markets and refining capacity
Maritime shipping logistics, insurance and alternative routes (Arctic, Suez bypass)
Regional military deployments, alliances and deterrence (US, Gulf states, Israel, Iran proxies)
Aviation security, civil aviation regulation and airline operational safety

variables.name: Regional oil export flow
variables.description: The volumetric rate of crude oil and condensate exported from the region through maritime routes (barrels per day equivalent).

variables.name: Tanker transit rate
variables.description: The number of commercial tanker transits through key regional waterways per unit time.

variables.name: Maritime attack incidence
variables.description: The frequency and intensity of hostile actions against ships and offshore infrastructure in the regional maritime domain.

variables.name: Aviation security incident rate
variables.description: The rate of in-flight or airport security breaches and violent incidents affecting commercial aviation operations.

variables.name: Regional military presence
variables.description: The aggregate level of deployed military assets and patrols operating in and around the maritime and air corridors of the region.

variables.name: Insurance premium level
variables.description: The average cost level of marine and aviation insurance/war-risk premiums applicable to vessels and flights transiting the region.

variables.name: Shipping rerouting extent
variables.description: The proportion and average additional distance/time of commercial shipping voyages rerouted to avoid high-risk regional passages.

variables.name: Global oil price level
variables.description: The market price level for benchmark crude reflecting global supply-demand balances and risk premia.

variables.name: Refined product inventories
variables.description: The aggregate stock levels of refined fuels (diesel, gasoline, jet fuel) available in regional and global supply chains.

variables.name: Strategic petroleum reserve stock
variables.description: The quantity of government-held emergency crude and refined product reserves available for release to markets.

variables.name: Market volatility perception
variables.description: The perceived level of price and supply volatility among market participants, reflected in expectations and risk premia.

variables.name: Logistics capacity utilization
variables.description: The degree to which global and regional shipping, port, and overland logistics capacity are being used relative to available capacity.

variables.name: Refinery operational throughput
variables.description: The rate at which refinery processing capacity is operating to convert crude into refined products (barrels per day processed).

variables.name: Geopolitical tension level
variables.description: The overall intensity of political and diplomatic strain affecting the region, including proxy conflict dynamics and escalation risks.

variables.name: Information uncertainty
variables.description: The degree of ambiguity and conflicting information about events and intentions that influences decision‑making by markets and operators.

variables.name: Shipping and freight cost level
variables.description: The average cost level for maritime transport services, including freight rates, security surcharges, and bunker costs.

catalysts.title: OPEC+ November quota decision
catalysts.description: OPEC+ to confirm November output targets; decision will influence near‑term market supply expectations and price risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'OPEC+ set to hold November oil quotas steady' / 'OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep November oil output targets steady.'

catalysts.title: IEA to set diesel/crude release details
catalysts.description: IEA/G7 to finalise mechanics and timing for the agreed 100mn barrel diesel/crude release, affecting inventories and prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'IEA to decide on details of diesel stocks release next week' and 'G-7 Agrees to Release 100 Million Barrels.'

catalysts.title: G7/IEA emergency stock release
catalysts.description: Actual physical releases of the agreed emergency diesel/crude barrels into markets, easing immediate supply tightness.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'G-7 Agrees to Release 100 Million Barrels' and G7/IEA stock release coverage.

catalysts.title: Iran keeps Strait of Hormuz closed until conditions met
catalysts.description: Iran's statement that the Strait won't reopen until its conditions are satisfied sustains transit risk and higher security premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran says Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until conditions are met' and 'rebounding exports vulnerable.'

catalysts.title: Houthis escalate; Saudi planning assault
catalysts.description: Houthi strikes on airports/energy sites and Saudi plans for an assault escalate maritime and regional military dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthis claim strike on Saudi Aramco facility', 'Yemen's Houthis say they attacked...', 'Saudis plan assault on Houthis.'

catalysts.title: Chinese refiners suspend October fuel exports
catalysts.description: Chinese refiners' suspension of October fuel exports tightens regional refined supply and raises price pressure in Asia.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Chinese refiners suspend October fuel exports to bolster stocks.'

catalysts.title: U.S. carrier and troop deployments to Middle East
catalysts.description: U.S. sending additional carrier/troops and repositioning bombers alters military posture and deterrence dynamics in the region.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Sending Third Aircraft Carrier, Up to 10,000 More Troops' and 'All B-1 Bombers Returning to U.S. From U.K. Base.'

catalysts.title: Yemeni government retakes Red Sea port areas
catalysts.description: Ongoing Yemeni government offensives to clear Houthi-held Red Sea ports could reopen safer transit lanes through Bab el-Mandeb.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Yemen forces reclaim key Red Sea port city' and 'Yemeni government forces drive Houthis from Bab el-Mandeb Strait.'

catalysts.title: Tanker crew premiums and implied tanker shortage
catalysts.description: Surging payments to captains and sailors to transit risk zones indicate tightening tanker availability and sharply higher shipping costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Shippers Are Offering Sailors Up to $25,000', 'Ships’ captains paid $100,000 a month to transit Strait of Hormuz.'

catalysts.title: Cardon refinery outage after fire
catalysts.description: Fire-induced halt at Venezuela's Cardon refinery reduces regional refined product supply and tightens product inventories.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Venezuela's Cardon refinery halted after fire, sources say.'
